title.narrative: Partnership Activity between The Lepresy Mission in Bangladesh and Danish Kherwara Msision

description.narrative: Danish Kherwara Mission (DKM) and The Leprosy Mission in Bangladesh (TLMI-B) will do a partnership conference i Dhaka, March 2024. The patnership has taken its form since 2023 and now it is time to consituate a mutual Partnership Agrrement. Among the many projects govern by TLMI-B is a women crises center called “Hagar". Hagar offers shelter and rehabilitation to women in deep crises and their children. The partnership between TLMI-B and DKM will focus on how to co-support and develop Hagar and the work there. During the partnership activity a delegation from DKM will spend a few days at Hagar center to get a deeper undersanding and insight into the strengths and callenges they are facing. Derived out of these insights the partneship conference in Dhaka will seek to confirm shared values and lay a strategy how DKM can co-support and develop the work at Hagar in the furture, which will be written into the Partnership Aggreement.
